definitions.similar: Figures with congruent matching angles and proportional corresponding side lengths.
definitions.dilation: A transformation scaling distances from a fixed center by one factor.
definitions.scale factor: Image length divided by matching preimage length in a dilation.
definitions.corresponding sides: Sides occupying matching positions in two corresponding figures.
definitions.proportion: An equation asserting equality of two ratios.
definitions.indirect measurement: Determining an unreachable distance from similar figures or measured scale ratios.
definitions.scale drawing: A representation drawn to a constant ratio of drawing length to actual length.
